chunks: "Indeed, ʿAlī عليه السلام did not perform ghusl for ʿAmmār ibn Yāsir nor Hāshim ibn ʿUtbah, who is al-Mirqāl, and he buried them in their clothes with their blood, and he did not perform funeral salat over them."
Thus it was narrated, but the foundational principle is that no one from the community, when he dies, should be left without funeral salat.

key_terms.بِدِمَائِهِمَا: with their blood still upon them
key_terms.دَفَنَهُمَا: he buried the two of them
key_terms.يُصَلِّ: to perform salat, here funeral prayer

ai.seo_question: Did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام ever bury martyrs without washing them or praying over them?
ai.summary: This report states that Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام buried ʿAmmār ibn Yāsir and Hāshim ibn ʿUtbah in their blood-stained clothes without washing them or performing funeral salat over them. The closing line clarifies a general legal principle: ordinarily, no member of the Muslim community should be left without funeral prayer.
